title: Topic 6: Home & Where You Live - Reading
description: Two short texts with three questions each.
canDoStatement: Name rooms and furniture; describe your home simply

readingBlock.readingText:
TEXT A - House advertisement format
HOUSE FOR YOU - SANTOS
A very nice house in the city of Santos!
There are three bedrooms and two bathrooms.
The kitchen is big, and there is a small room
for an office.
Call Rosa: 9 7 7 2.

TEXT B - Chat messages format
Mel:  Hi Ciro! Are you happy in your new apartment?
Ciro: Yes! It is small - there is one bedroom and
      one bathroom.
Mel:  Is there a kitchen?
Ciro: Yes, and there is a big table in it.
Mel:  Nice! Where is my photo?
Ciro: On the table, in the kitchen!

readingQuestions.question: The house is in Santos. True or false?
What are Mel and Ciro talking about?
How many bedrooms are there in the apartment?
Where is Mel's photo?
options: On the table in the kitchen
readingQuestions.correctAnswer: On the table in the kitchen
